title: Investigating NAC Transcription Factor Role in Redox Homeostasis in Solanum lycopersicum L.: Bioinformatics, Physiological and Expression Analysis under Drought Stress.
authors: Rai, Nagendra; Rai, Krishna Kumar; Singh, Manish Kumar; Singh, Jagdish; Kaushik, Prashant
one_liner_zh: 该文结合生物信息学与生理实验研究番茄NAC转录因子在干旱胁迫下的表达，并通过同源建模与DNA对接预测SlNAC1与DNA的互作残基，虽涉及TF-DNA互作建模但深度有限，方法以常规对接为主，AI/物理模拟创新不足。
abstract: NAC transcription factors regulate stress-defence pathways and developmental processes in crop plants. However, their detailed functional characterization in tomatoes needs to be investigated comprehensively. In the present study, tomato hybrids subjected to 60 and 80 days of drought stress conditions showed a significant increase in membrane damage and reduced relative water, chlorophyll and proline content. However, hybrids viz., VRTH-16-3 and VRTH-17-68 showed superior growth under drought stress, as they were marked with low electrolytic leakage, enhanced relative water content, proline content and an enhanced activity of enzymatic antioxidants, along with the upregulation of NAC and other stress-defence pathway genes. Candidate gene(s) exhibiting maximum expression in all the hybrids under drought stress were subjected to detailed in silico characterization to provide significant insight into its structural and functional classification. The homology modelling and superimposition analysis of predicted tomato NAC protein showed that similar amino acid residues were involved in forming the conserved WKAT domain. DNA docking discovered that the SlNAC1 protein becomes activated and exerts a stress-defence response after the possible interaction of conserved DNA elements using Pro(72), Asn(73), Trp(81), Lys(82), Ala(83), Thr(84), Gly(85), Thr(86) and Asp(87) residues. A protein-protein interaction analysis identified ten functional partners involved in the induction of stress-defence tolerance.
abstract_zh: NAC转录因子调控作物植物的胁迫防御途径和发育过程。然而，其在番茄中的详细功能表征仍需全面研究。在本研究中，经历60天和80天干旱胁迫条件的番茄杂交种显示出膜损伤显著增加，以及相对含水量、叶绿素和脯氨酸含量降低。然而，杂交种如VRTH-16-3和VRTH-17-68在干旱胁迫下表现出优越的生长，其特征为低电解质渗漏、增强的相对含水量、脯氨酸含量以及酶促抗氧化剂活性增强，同时NAC和其他胁迫防御途径基因上调。在干旱胁迫下所有杂交种中表现出最大表达的候选基因进行了详细的计算机模拟表征，以提供对其结构和功能分类的重要见解。预测的番茄NAC蛋白的同源建模和叠加分析显示，相似的氨基酸残基参与形成保守的WKAT结构域。DNA对接发现，SlNAC1蛋白在保守DNA元件可能通过Pro(72)、Asn(73)、Trp(81)、Lys(82)、Ala(83)、Thr(84)、Gly(85)、Thr(86)和Asp(87)残基相互作用后被激活，并发挥胁迫防御反应。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析确定了十个参与诱导胁迫防御耐受性的功能伙伴。
